title: finding(plugin-detail): DetailView's own record header pushes the page sideways below the sm breakpoint — a long title sizes the column and min-w-0 never constrains it
body:
Found while taking the browser measurements for objectui#7281 on the same header. It is **not** that card's hazard and objectui#7281's fix does not touch it: both readings below were taken twice, once on `origin/main` `d8b4739` and once with objectui#7281's two utilities applied, and they are identical to the pixel. Filed rather than fixed there because objectui#7281's fences are explicit — two headers, the title/action arbitration only, no DOM restructuring — and this is a different failure of the same element.

## The reading

Chromium, the console dev server, the `detail` component type rendered directly (that is the registration that renders this header: `ComponentRegistry.register('detail', DetailView, ...)`), record title `Specimen — Full · Northwind Traders Consolidated Quarterly Revenue Reconciliation Worksheet (EMEA)`:

| viewport | header row | title column | h1 rect | h1 scrollWidth | clipped? | document overflow X |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 320px | 320px | **1201.22px** | 1153.22px | 1153px | no | **881px** |
| 375px | 375px | **1201.22px** | 1153.22px | 1153px | no | **826px** |
| 639px | 639px | **1201.22px** | 1153.22px | 1153px | no | **562px** |
| 799px | 799px | 799px | 747px | 1387px | yes | 0 |

At and above the `sm` breakpoint the title ellipsises and nothing overflows. Below it the title does not ellipsise at all: the column is three times the width of the row it sits in, and the document gains that much horizontal scroll.

## Mechanism

Below `sm` the row is a COLUMN flex container — `flex flex-col sm:flex-row ... items-start` — so the title column's width is its cross size, and `align-items: flex-start` sizes a cross axis to fit-content. The column therefore takes the h1's max-content width. `min-w-0` on that column is a floor, not a ceiling, so it does not constrain this at all, and `flex-1` acts on the main axis (height) in a column container, not on width. The `truncate` on the h1 never fires because its containing block was sized to the text.

The threshold is low. The 92-character title above measured 1153px, roughly 12.5px per character, so on a 375px phone any record name past about thirty characters pushes the page sideways.

## What was NOT measured

Whether an ancestor in the real console clips this instead of scrolling. The reading above is taken with the header mounted in an unconstrained container, which is what isolates the header's own behaviour; a host with `overflow-x-hidden` somewhere above would convert the symptom from "the page scrolls sideways" into "the title is cut off with no ellipsis". Either way the header sizes itself wrong; which of the two a user sees is the open half.

## Not to be confused with

- objectui#7244 and objectui#7281 — the arbitration between the title column and the action tail, at and above `sm`. Fixed; the table's 799px row is the fixed state.
- objectui#3466 / objectui#2493 — both closed, both a missing `min-w-0` on a different surface. Here `min-w-0` is present and is simply the wrong tool for a cross-axis size.

Reported by an ObjectUI development agent (Claude Code) while delivering objectui#7281; readings are from that session's browser measurements.
